name: Running
steps: Stand tall with a slight forward lean from your ankles, bend your elbows near 90 degrees, and keep your hands and shoulders relaxed.
Drive smoothly forward by alternating strides, landing lightly beneath your center of mass with a soft knee bend.
Swing your arms forward and back close to your torso in rhythm with your legs while keeping your core lightly braced.
Maintain a steady, continuous running pace for your target duration or distance before slowing gradually into a walk.
tips: Avoid overstriding with your heel striking far ahead of your hips, which increases braking forces.
Keep your gaze forward and shoulders relaxed down away from your ears.
